note: The environment both suites read to reach a real warehouse. Held here so the two harnesses cannot drift on a variable name. Connection variables are the vendor's own, so one export block serves both languages and the vendor CLIs. Databricks credentials are left to the vendor's unified authentication, which resolves DATABRICKS_TOKEN, a DATABRICKS_CLIENT_ID with a secret or GitHub Actions OIDC, or a Databricks CLI login, so none is named here. Snowflake signs in with a key pair, the one method a service user and a person share. Each fixture variable names one dotted identifier, except a parameterized model's arguments, which are a JSON object. A backend whose required variables are unset skips; an optional fixture skips only the tests that need it.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request with a service principal's client secret, space-separated, such as `sql`. Set it when the secret is scoped; a scoped secret refuses the `all-apis` scope both clients request by default. Databricks has no variable of its own for this.

schema.description: Catalog and schema holding the provisioned tables, as `catalog.schema`. The table names themselves come from live-warehouse-rows.json.

denied_table.description: A relation the test principal genuinely cannot read. Provisioning with --grant-to creates one, owned by the principal that runs the SQL (on Snowflake, its active role).

parameterized_model.description: A metric view with at least one parameter and one metric. Read by the R suite only: pkg-py has no semantic-model surface (commons kata gcgj).

parameterized_model_arguments.description: The arguments to call the parameterized model with, as a JSON object. Needed alongside it.

schema.description: Database and schema holding the provisioned tables, as `database.schema`.

denied_table.description: A relation the test role genuinely cannot read.

alternate_role.description: A second usable role, for the active-role change test.

semantic_view.description: A semantic view. Read by the R suite only, as with the Databricks metric view.

verified_query_view.description: A semantic view carrying a verified query. Read by the R suite only.

parameterized_model.description: A semantic view with at least one variable and one metric. Read by the R suite only.

parameterized_model_arguments.description: The arguments to call the parameterized model with, as a JSON object. Needed alongside it.

env_file.note: A developer may keep these variables in a git-ignored .env at the repository root. Each suite reads it with its language's standard reader, python-dotenv and base R's readRenviron(), and only when the tests run from a checkout, so a missing file or an installed package changes nothing. These cases are the part of the format both readers agree on: KEY=value lines, blank lines and # comment lines skipped, one pair of quotes stripped, backslashes kept inside single quotes, ${VAR} expanded from earlier lines of the file and then from the environment, ~ left alone, and the last of a repeated name kept. The readers differ on comments after a value, an export prefix, a line without '=', an empty value, and backslashes inside double quotes. A variable already set in the environment wins over the file, and the file's variables last only for the test run.

cases.name: blank lines and comments are skipped
one pair of quotes is stripped
backslashes inside single quotes are kept
${VAR} expands from the environment and ~ does not
${VAR} expands from an earlier line before the environment
the last of a repeated name is kept
a variable set in the environment wins, even when empty
a file whose every variable is already set changes nothing
